summary: Master the art of retail sales and visual merchandising with our expert-led training course. Elevate your career and drive sales success in your store!
lede: Retail merchandising connects product presentation, store layout and selling conversations to support customer conversion. For retail professionals responsible for physical stores, it develops practical skills in planning shelf space and store zones, shaping displays and customer interactions, and reviewing performance through footfall, conversion and basket-value measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for retail professionals who manage sales floors, product presentation, and customer conversion in physical stores.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with retail store operations, customer service, or merchandising workflows. No design software or coding is required, but a working knowledge of store layouts, product categories, and retail sales targets will help you apply the exercises faster. This course is strongest for people who can review display photos, shelf plans, and sales data from their own store or department.
